exposure: Placental dark T2 bands area (MRI parameter)
Placental signals in the cervix (MRI parameter)
outcome: Sensitivity of MRI for PAS diagnosis
Specificity of MRI for PAS diagnosis
Area Under the Curve (AUC) for MRI diagnosis of PAS
cohort: Pregnant women with central placenta previa (CPP), including 90 women with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) and 66 women without PAS.
finding: MRI of the lower uterine segment demonstrated high sensitivity (82.22%) and specificity (91.09%) for the diagnosis of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) in pregnant women with central placenta previa (CPP), and women with PAS experienced significantly longer operative times, more intrapartum hemorrhage, and higher rates of blood transfusion.
